physicalNotes: Radius 1.026 Jupiter radii from Nielsen et al. 2019 (2019A&A...623A.100N), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...623A.100N/abstract): 73,350.8 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.415 Jupiter masses (Nielsen et al. 2019, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2019A&A...623A.100N), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...623A.100N/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
